emoji.attribution: Unicode, Inc., Unicode Emoji18.0. Original notices retained. Derived selection and JavaScript wrapper; sequences/names/group order unchanged.

ico_encoder.type: Reviewed local bounded PNG-frame ICO packer; no third-party runtime encoder
ico_encoder.validation: Independent Windows icon reader and PNG-frame decoding required before TESTED.

other_runtime_dependencies: Native browser image codecs, print CSS and unchanged Tailwind/consent. No production npm dependency.

png_resolution_metadata.method: Reviewed local pHYs insertion/replacement; nominal DPI rounded to integer pixels/metre, CRC32 validated, image payload unchanged.
png_resolution_metadata.validation: Independent chunk/payload tests plus real PNG pixel and print/PDF geometry tests.

excel_reference_validation.scope: A1 cells/ranges with Excel grid bounds; quoted sheet names with a conservative31 UTF-16-unit cap, invalid characters/edge apostrophes/blank/History rejected. No external references, evaluation or locale-name translation.
